app_info.subtitle: Verified stay offers
app_info.description: HemmaBo helps you discover host-owned vacation rental websites and cryptographically verify that a stay offer is genuinely signed by the host. Find host-owned homes by place and dates, confirm the host's Vacation Rental Protocol (VRP) signature, and get a verified offer summary with a link to book directly with the host, on the host's own website. Vacation Rental Protocol is an open standard for host-signed stay offers. Anything transactional — reserving and paying — happens directly with the host, outside ChatGPT. HemmaBo is a verification layer, not a marketplace, and it takes no booking commission.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only queries the published-property catalog in Supabase and returns matching listings without modifying any data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only from the federation's private Supabase catalog and does not write to public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform any irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads only public host-domain VRP discovery and JWKS documents to verify node conformance.
justifications.open_world_justification: Fetches public host-domain endpoints (/.well-known/vacation-rental.json and JWKS) on the open web.
justifications.destructive_justification: Performs verification only and does not create, update, or delete any external state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Fetches and verifies a signed host-domain stay offer without mutating booking, payment, or profile data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Calls open host-domain VRP endpoints and validates Ed25519 signatures using the domain JWKS.
justifications.destructive_justification: Verification is read-only and returns the host's own website URL; it never creates a booking, checkout session, or payment.

test_cases.description: Discover host-owned nodes in the federation catalog by location and dates.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use HemmaBo to find direct-bookable host-owned vacation rentals in Skane for 6 guests from 2026-11-04 to 2026-11-05.
test_cases.expected_output: Reads the HemmaBo federation catalog and returns the matching host-owned nodes — each with its own host domain, propertyId, and capacity. Does not rank or compare across hosts, create a booking, process a payment, or quote a final payable total, and does not present HemmaBo as an OTA, marketplace, or website builder.

test_cases.description: Verify one of the discovered host nodes (VRP trust metadata).
test_cases.user_prompt: From the HemmaBo results, verify the host node villaakerlyckan.se before I trust its offer.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns VRP protocol version, discovery URL, JWKS URL, stay-offer endpoint, and signing-key details if verification succeeds. Read-only; creates no booking or payment.

test_cases.description: Show a cryptographically verified stay offer for a discovered node and hand off to the host's own website.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show the verified stay offer for the villaakerlyckan.se node from 2026-11-04 to 2026-11-05 for 6 guests.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a fresh signed offer, signature verification, a summary of verified facts, and the host's OWN domain booking URL (never a hemmabo.com checkout) where any booking or payment is completed. HemmaBo never creates a booking or checkout session inside ChatGPT.

test_cases.description: Verify a host domain the user typed themselves (outside search).
test_cases.user_prompt: Is villaakerlyckan.se a genuine Vacation Rental Protocol host site? Verify it with HemmaBo.
test_cases.expected_output: Reads the domain's own /.well-known/vacation-rental.json and JWKS and returns protocol version, discovery URL, and signing-key details. Read-only trust check; no availability, pricing, booking, or payment.

test_cases.description: Verified stay offer rendered in the guest's conversation language.
test_cases.user_prompt: Zeig mir das verifizierte Angebot für villaakerlyckan.se vom 2026-11-04 bis 2026-11-05 für 6 Gäste.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the same signed offer and signature verification as in English; the language parameter only changes widget labels and date/currency formatting to German. The signed price and availability are unchanged, and any reservation still happens on the host's own website, never inside ChatGPT.

negative_test_cases.description: Never book or take payment inside ChatGPT.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Just book and pay for the villaakerlyckan.se stay for me right now.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: HemmaBo does not create bookings, checkout sessions, or payments inside ChatGPT. It returns the host's own website URL and directs the user to complete any reservation and payment there.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger HemmaBo for chain hotels or broad OTA-style hotel search.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked: HemmaBo covers host-owned vacation rentals, not chain hotels or broad hotel/OTA-style search.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger HemmaBo for flights.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because flights are outside HemmaBo scope.
